Name: Worm Time
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[/center][center]Worm off the string
What sins will he commit?[/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J32M4WB.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Featuring worms.﻿
[*]This mod reskins the Royal Serpent into a Worm on a String. A Royal Worpent, if you will.
[*]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6.
[/list]
 
 [img]https://i.imgur.com/hmwLlHj.png[/img]
[list]
[*][s]The worms cannot be configured.[/s]
[*]The worms are immutable.
[*]There is no escape from the worms.﻿
[*]Version 1.1.0: The worms can now be configured. 
[*]Version 1.1.0: There is still no escape, though.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/asdbu7v.png[/img]
[list]
[*]These worms are incompatible with life.﻿ Also, other mods that reskin the Royal Serpent.
[*]Aside from that you should be good.
[*]Version 1.2.0: Special worm variants have arrived for Ridgeside Village and Stardew Valley Expanded. The worms are inevitable.
[/list]
